# AOZU

> A browser workshop for reusable layered characters, world settings, albums and storyboards. Creative data stays in this browser; export backups before switching devices.

Application: https://aozu.mantle.tools/
Source: https://github.com/guyspy/aozu
Character authoring guide: /character-authoring.md (ships with this deployment)

Start with inspect_workspace, then inspect_character_contract for the exact
Character target. Read the versioned authoring guide once and follow the live
contract's workflow, metadataStatus, revision/hash and visual review instructions.

Canonical Body is the shared A-pose base. Wardrobe contains garment-only
transparent overlays. A dressed working image is temporary and is never a
Wardrobe submission. Hair/headwear/props use registered front/back layers;
handheld props may include a minimal gripping-hand patch. Facial Variants cover
makeup, face paint, facial hair and other face changes, each with its own
consistent whole-head expression set. Appearance means a saved combination.

Use the page's currently registered tools, not a copied static tool inventory.
update_character_variant_metadata records asset descriptions and classifications;
replace_character_asset submits the final layer. For small compatible base
corrections preserve existing layers; major redesigns need a new Character.

AOZU does not generate images or remove backgrounds. Never burn in a checkerboard.
Transfer complete PNG bytes directly from host memory when supported, otherwise
follow the contract's visible file-chooser fallback. Tool acceptance is not
visual review or user approval. Follow navigation performed by AOZU and inspect
the actual result before continuing.
